name: Add Attachment To Card
description: Adds a file attachment on a card. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-cards/#api-cards-id-attachments-post)

configurable_props.name: board
configurable_props.label: Board
configurable_props.description: The Trello board you wish to select

configurable_props.name: cardId
configurable_props.label: Card
configurable_props.description: The ID of the Card to add the Attachment to

configurable_props.name: file
configurable_props.label: File Path or URL
configurable_props.description: Provide either a file URL or a path to a file in the /tmp directory (for example, /tmp/myFile.pdf).

configurable_props.name: mimeType
configurable_props.label: Mime Type
configurable_props.description: Mime type of the attached file. Eg. `application/pdf`

configurable_props.name: setCover
configurable_props.label: Set Cover?
configurable_props.description: Determines whether to use the new attachment as a cover for the Card
